description:
The static/dynamic interleaving model in %Rendered{} assumes a fixed number of dynamic slots. A {for x <- list do}…{end} block produces variable-length output. Phoenix solves this with %Phoenix.LiveView.Comprehension{} — the for-expression occupies a single dynamic slot whose value is a Comprehension struct, which the diff engine expands independently. READ FIRST: - lib/filament/vnode_compiler.ex (hoist_dynamics — the for case must be handled here) - lib/filament/tag_engine.ex (how the for block is emitted in the AST) - deps/phoenix_live_view/lib/phoenix_live_view/engine.ex (Comprehension struct definition) - deps/phoenix_live_view/lib/phoenix_live_view/diff.ex (how Comprehension is traversed) %Phoenix.LiveView.Comprehension{} STRUCT: Look up its definition in deps/phoenix_live_view/lib/phoenix_live_view/engine.ex. It holds: static: [String.t()] — static parts of the loop body template dynamics: [[dyn()]] — list of dynamic-lists, one per iteration fingerprint: integer — MD5 of the loop body statics (same algorithm as %Rendered{}) stream: nil | atom — leave nil The diff engine handles Comprehension by iterating over dynamics and interleaving with static. HOW THE FOR BLOCK APPEARS IN THE AST: After T3, a {for x <- list do}…{end} block in a ~F template is parsed by Filament.TagEngine. The engine will emit something like: for x <- list do %Phoenix.LiveView.Rendered{static: ["
  • ", "
    • "], dynamic: fn _ -> [x.text] end, …} end This for-expression appears as a single dynamic slot in the parent template. WHAT TO DO: In VNodeCompiler's hoist_dynamics pass, detect when a dynamic slot expression is a for comprehension (quoted AST with head {:for, _, _} or a for-loop expression). When detected: 1. Extract the loop variable binding and the enumerable (e.g., `x <- list`) 2. Extract the loop body template (the inner %Rendered{} emitted per iteration) 3. From the inner %Rendered{}, extract: static list, and the dynamic slot expressions 4. Build a %Phoenix.LiveView.Comprehension{} by: - Setting static: to the inner template's static list - Setting dynamics: to a quoted for-expression that evaluates the inner dynamic slots for each iteration: `for x <- list do [d0_expr, d1_expr, …] end` - Computing fingerprint from the inner static list (same MD5 algorithm) - Setting stream: nil 5. Hoist the entire Comprehension construction as a single `_dN = %Comprehension{…}` binding before the parent %Rendered{} struct 6. The parent dynamic slot becomes `_dN` (a %Comprehension{}, not iodata) IMPORTANT: Do NOT call live_to_iodata on the Comprehension value — the diff engine pattern-matches on the struct type. The dynamics list inside the Comprehension holds raw expressions, not iodata-wrapped ones. ACCEPTANCE: - `mix test` passes - Chrome: localhost:4000 — add three todos; verify all three render (exercises the for loop) - Chrome: toggle one todo as complete; click Active filter — verify only the two active todos are shown (exercises comprehension with filter applied to the list) - Chrome: click Completed filter — verify only the completed todo is shown - Chrome: click All filter — verify all three todos are shown - The todo list items must render with correct text and checkbox state on each filter change
title: {for} blocks emit %Phoenix.LiveView.Comprehension{} structs
